Creating and naming an S3 bucket.
Choose a globally unique S3 bucket name and select a region when you create the bucket.
Bucket naming rules restrict characters and length for the S3 bucket.
This page covers S3 bucket creation and naming conventions only.
Last updated: 2026-06-01

Launching an EC2 instance with an instance profile.
Attach an IAM role through an instance profile so the EC2 instance can call AWS APIs.
Select an AMI, instance type, and key pair when launching the EC2 instance.
This page is about EC2 instances and IAM roles, not storage lifecycles.
Last updated: 2021-05-05

Expiring noncurrent versions with an S3 lifecycle configuration.
Use a lifecycle rule containing NoncurrentVersionExpiration to expire noncurrent object versions automatically.
Set NoncurrentDays so the lifecycle policy removes noncurrent versions once they age out.
This guide covers how to expire noncurrent object versions in an S3 lifecycle policy.
Last updated: 2024-03-15

How to expire noncurrent object versions in an S3 lifecycle policy.
Define a lifecycle rule with NoncurrentVersionExpiration to expire noncurrent object versions after NoncurrentDays.
The lifecycle policy then expires noncurrent versions on the configured schedule.
This is the current recommended way to expire noncurrent object versions.
Last updated: 2026-02-20

S3 lifecycle policy: expiring noncurrent object versions.
To expire noncurrent object versions, add a lifecycle rule with a NoncurrentVersionExpiration action.
The rule deletes older noncurrent versions after the specified number of noncurrent days.
This is the primary mechanism to expire noncurrent object versions in an S3 lifecycle policy.
Last updated: 2022-01-10

S3 lifecycle transitions and version management overview.
A lifecycle policy can transition object versions between storage classes and manage noncurrent versions.
Lifecycle rules apply to current and noncurrent versions across the bucket.
This overview touches on lifecycle policies and object versions at a high level.
Last updated: 2025-08-01
